description: Use it when someone asks: is my AI system high risk, does the EU AI Act apply to my chatbot, to my hiring or CV screening tool, to our credit scoring model, what risk category are we in, what are my obligations and when do they start, am I a provider or a deployer, does it apply to a US company selling into the EU, do we have to register in the EU database, what is the fine if we get this wrong, is this banned, must we tell users they are talking to an AI, must we label AI generated content or deep fakes, what applies to a general purpose AI model. Classifies a system under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 from the caller's description and returns the risk class, the obligations with article numbers, the date they apply and the fine ceiling. The Annex III list, the Article 6(3) exemption and the staggered application dates are the parts most often got wrong.

annex_iii_use_case.description: One of: None | 1(a) Remote biometric identification | 1(b) Biometric categorisation by sensitive attributes | 1(c) Emotion recognition | 2 Critical infrastructure safety component | 3(a) Education access or admission | 3(b) Evaluating learning outcomes | 3(c) Level of education | 3(d) Test monitoring | 4(a) Recruitment and selection | 4(b) Employment decisions and monitoring | 5(a) Public benefits eligibility | 5(b) Creditworthiness or credit scoring | 5(c) Life and health insurance pricing | 5(d) Emergency call triage | 6(a) to 6(e) Law enforcement | 7(a) to 7(d) Migration and border | 8(a) Justice | 8(b) Elections. Default None.

exempt_under_article_6_3.description: Falls in Annex III but does not pose significant risk.

prohibited_practice.description: One of: None | 5(1)(a) Manipulative or deceptive techniques | 5(1)(b) Exploiting vulnerabilities | 5(1)(c) Social scoring | 5(1)(d) Predictive policing on profiling alone | 5(1)(e) Untargeted facial scraping | 5(1)(f) Workplace or school emotion inference | 5(1)(g) Sensitive biometric categorisation | 5(1)(h) Real-time remote biometric ID for law enforcement. Default None.

role.description: Provider, Deployer, Importer or Distributor. Default Provider.

safety_component_article_6_1.description: A safety component of a product covered by Union harmonisation legislation.

transparency_obligation_article_50.description: Interacts with people, or generates synthetic content, deep fakes or emotion recognition.

worldwide_annual_turnover_eur.description: Sets the fine ceiling, which is the greater of the fixed amount and a percentage of turnover.
